sp_intro: This page explains what data the {brand} website collects about you when you browse it, use the support form, or write a review.

p: Support form: your name, email, message, and the app and message type you choose. We use them only to reply to you, and they are stored by Netlify Forms.

Reviews: your star rating, text, and the name you type (optional). We do not ask for your email and there are no accounts. A review is shown to visitors only after we review it, and we may delete any abusive or non-compliant review.

Visit statistics: we count opened website pages and download-button clicks as aggregated daily totals. We use no cookies, store no IP address or personal identifier, and do not track you across pages or sites. The count is skipped if your browser sends a “Do Not Track” signal.

Abuse prevention: to protect the review form and admin sign-in from automated repetition, we compute a one-way hash of your IP address with a secret value that changes daily, and use it only to count attempts. The address cannot be recovered from it.
Storage on your device: we save your dark or light mode choice on your device only.
The website contains no ads and no third-party analytics tools.

The website is hosted, and its forms, reviews and statistics are stored, with Netlify, which may keep technical server logs under its own policy. The website's source code is kept on GitHub and contains no visitor data.
You can ask us to delete your message, your review, or any data about you by contacting us at {contact}.
The website is not directed at children under 13.
We may update this policy; the last-updated date is shown at the top.

faq1_q: How do I report a problem?
faq1_a: Send the form above with the app name, device type, Android version and the steps to reproduce the problem.
faq2_q: When will the app be available to download?
faq2_a: The download button or Google Play link appears on the app page once it is actually available. If it does not appear, it is not available yet.
faq3_q: How do I ask for my data to be deleted?
faq3_a: Choose “Privacy or data deletion request” in the form.
